Construct · 1 hex · SM -1 Flying Sword [Monsters on Automatic, SRD coverage: constructs, animated objects and awakened plants; answers Flying Sword (SRD 5.1)]

A sword hanging point-down at chest height, turning slowly to face whoever came in. It fights like a duellist with no body to threaten and no face to read, and the only reliable way to end it is to break the blade.

Notes

  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/flying-sword.gct
  • Independent build total: 130 points of racial traits plus 4 points of racial skills.
  • Answers the SRD heading(s): Flying Sword (SRD 5.1). Only the creature identity is taken from the SRD; the GURPS statistics, ratings and prose are this project's own work and reproduce no SRD text.
  • Typical Stats, damage and ratings are derived from the racial template, not authored beside it, so the sheet and the stat block cannot disagree.
  • Body mass used to scale this build: 1.5 kg. ST, Size Modifier and DR are checked against it; see the gurps-animal-sanity-check skill for the bands.
  • Movement: ground Move 6; air Move 12 (primary). The published Move is the primary medium's cruising Move; sprint figures are stated here and not folded into it.
  • Treasure and grappling are not authored for this batch and ship as explicit nulls; `lair` carries a short habitat note, because where a wandering animal dens is an encounter fact rather than a loot one.
  • A longsword is about 1.1 m, which is the SM -1 row.
  • Damage is stated as literal dice rather than derived from ST: the injury comes from the edge and the enchantment, not from a Strength that does not exist. The builder takes literal dice only where a spec states them.
  • Flight is bought at full price with no Winged limitation — the thing simply hangs in the air, and nothing about it can be grounded by clipping a wing.
